evidence: Running bash run_repro.sh prints "marimo import ok" to stdout and then fails with IndexError: list index out of range from codebase/marimo/_plugins/ui/_impl/tabs.py:101 when mo.ui.tabs({}) is called.
steps: Create the virtualenv and install requirements with ./setup_env.sh
Run ./run_repro.sh with PYTHONPATH pointing at codebase/
Inspect repro_stderr.log for the IndexError traceback from mo.ui.tabs({})
